summary: Sandbach United got their 2026/27 season off to a winning start with a 3-1 victory over Wednesfield CFC in their first league fixture, with goals from Bevan (twice) and Hatton securing the three points. The team showed great early cohesion despite fielding five new players in the starting lineup, though they had to weather a freak equaliser late in the first half. The Ramblers are looking sharp and ready to push forward as the new season gets underway.
